text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *wheeze*... *huff*...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No... I can't let my feet stop here. I 
can't... Come on...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because I am... a first-rate—

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Man, what an incredible match! Those two 
really make you look forward to what's 
next.

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text: —Seiun Sky and Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Restless Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, will it be the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
next? Or maybe the Arima Kinen!?

text_block_list.name: Restless Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm so excited to see what they do 
next year! I've definitely gotta cheer for 
both of them!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so stupid...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...No one is even... watching anymore..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Was I mistaken, I wonder? Should I not 
have taken on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: To be so utterly pathetic...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: See? It turned out just like she said.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just having the spotlight 
stolen—they wouldn't even pay attention to 
me anymore.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is far from first-class—
choice_data_list: King Halo is a first-rate horse girl!

King Halo is a first-rate horse girl, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Stop it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Stop being so stubborn and look at 
reality! Right now, I can't even—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —King-san!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Kawakami-san? What are you doing 
here?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I came to cheer for you! You were truly, 
truly wonderful once again!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Your powerful stride, that instantaneous 
sharpness. And above all else—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Never slowing down no matter the 
course—such a beautiful sight! I just love 
it!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Kawakami-san.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kiiing!! Great job out there!! You really 
ran the entire Triple Crown route to the 
end!!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That was truly incredible～...! I'll do my 
best so I can run for the Triple Crown 
someday too～!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You guys too...
choice_data_list: Not everyone refuses to acknowledge you

Not everyone fails to acknowledge you, you 
know.

text_block_list.text: —Even with this defeat.
choice_data_list:
I know because I've been watching you all 
this time.

I know, because I've been watching you all 
this time.

text_block_list.text:
No matter how frustrating things get, or 
even if people look at me in dismay.

Even if I can't produce results that will 
satisfy my mother—

No matter how many times her heart feels 
ready to break, she gets back up, keeps 
pushing forward, and captivates everyone. 
That is the kind of Umamusume she is.

Different from her mother, she is an 
Umamusume blessed with immense talent and 
a charm all her own.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. Not again, doing that over and 
over...!
choice_data_list:
I'll say it as many times as it 
takes—you're 'first-rate.'

I'll tell you as many times as it 
takes—you're 'first-rate.'

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously... you really are 
something...!
choice_data_list:
(――Because I'm one of those captivated by 
you, too.)

(—Because I'm also one of those captivated 
by you)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Dummy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...You really are a total klutz! At times 
like this... you should at least wrap 
things up properly!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, you're stubborn, 
persistent, inflexible, clumsy...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Just what I'd expect from my Trainer, 
refusing to give up to the bitter end...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"You're really... not cool at all, you 
know..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Why are we... so utterly useless...! 
Why are we like this...?!

And until her tears stopped, I decided to 
lend her my shoulder for a little while.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There was something you were trying to 
tell me before the Kikuka Sho, wasn't 
there?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, I can tell you now.

Yet she and her mother are different. 
There is always the possibility she might 
shine elsewhere—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I've already prepared myself.

King Halo's eyes were deadly serious as 
she spoke. If so, then now is the time—
choice_data_list:
I should stop trying to get my mother to 
notice me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're the one quitting...? I... totally 
thought...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought you were going to tell me to 
give up on long distances entirely..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was afraid you'd tell me to drop races I 
can't win, and only choose races that suit 
my skill and aptitudes...
choice_data_list:
Let's become first-rate in true King Halo 
fashion!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...That sounds just like me.

Not chasing after someone's back, and not 
for the sake of being recognized by 
someone else.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is that really okay? Is it really fine for 
me to do whatever I want?
choice_data_list: You need to walk your own path.
You need to walk your own path.

text_block_list.text:
A path that belongs solely to King Halo, 
uninfluenced by her mother or anyone else.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“—Not first-class for someone else's sake. 
My very own... first-class.”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—That sounds awfully interesting, doesn't 
it?
